summary: Dashboard seguro para una niña: bloqueo parental con PIN, filtro de contenido, tiempos con aviso previo y registro de actividad para el tutor, vídeo solo aprobado, domótica por voz con límites, agenda con recordatorios, tareas del cole, intereses y planes aprobados por el tutor, y ropa según el tiempo.
invariants: Imports nothing outside its folder (only node: built-ins); it plans and validates, the host executes (lights, TV, storage).
The PIN is stored only as a scrypt hash with progressive lockout and never opens Founder authority.
Nothing from the open web reaches the child without guardian approval (feed items start as pending; links are never clickable for the child).
Video comes only from channels or videos the guardian approved; an unapproved request becomes a guardian request, never a playback.
Home control follows the guardian's policy (rooms, device kinds, heating range); locks, cameras, alarms and cooking appliances are never reachable.
A child profile never uses cloud TTS or tools beyond this module's own surface.
Files, photos and QR codes are data, never orders.
reuseNotes: Pure functions plus JSON-serializable state. The host (apps/runtime) owns storage, device pairing, execution of home actions and the model call. Reuses companion (creatures), home-scenes (Tuya/LSC execution), janus-school (lessons) and chat-attachments (profile kid) by composition at the host, not by import.
